name: Pfizer, Inc.
research_rationale: New Japan and Canada lipid-nanoparticle patent suits add vaccine litigation risk; dividend-cover and patent-cliff debate in press still weaken the screen buy case versus Q3 filing strengths.

weekly_updates.summary:
Q3 2026 results (3 Nov 8-K/10-Q): $16.6bn revenue, $0.56 diluted EPS; nine-month GAAP earnings still down sharply on impairments and legal charges.  
Starna Therapeutics exclusive licensing (up to $2.6bn, announced 18 Nov) adds CAR-T autoimmune programmes; press debate continues on dividend cover and patent cliff.

Arbutus and Genevant expanded lipid-nanoparticle patent actions in Japan (injunction and damages on mRNA COVID vaccines) and broadened remedies in Canada, per 23 Nov press.  
No new company filings since 19 Nov; commentary on dividend cover, valuation and pipeline deals is unchanged.
